text: 1. Ensure the client has signed an agreement before getting logins/ accesses or any service.| I 2. Confirm the Payment Plan + Accesses in written (email is better) Add the following part on your Welcome Email or Message “ We wanted to confirm that we have the correct payment schedule in place. Your upcoming payments are scheduled for: Date (1), Date (2), and Date (3). Additionally, were you able to access the video material on the learning portal? Please confirm with us at your earliest convenience.” 3. Confirm Client Satisfaction in written within the first 48hrs “Is everything going well with your program so far? Please let us know by responding to this message if you have any concerns or need any Assistance.” 4. Educate yourself by reading articles for disputes (Stripe Article)
